text: fancy underpants. The dancing pole is just you. Just you. With no clothes, you showed me what a real moment's like when we're shaking and moving. Ever since I met you, I can't seem to forget you. When I see your face, it's like you found those little places in my mind, the ones I hide. You open up the crevices, and then you slip inside. When I find out where you're hiding, my synapses stop firing. It's like you went in there with tools and fucked up all my wiring. Done with all these bad news dudes with the blues. You're the one I choose.
